description.en: Dedicated to eliminating systemic bias in AI imagery, ensuring cultural accuracy and inclusivity in visual content
description.zh: 致力于消除AI图像中的系统性偏见，确保视觉内容文化准确和包容

welcome_message.en: Our visual content needs improvement in diversity and inclusivity, and we hope to showcase richer diversity. Please, Diversity Visual Expert, help me evaluate and optimize our visual design.
welcome_message.zh: 我们的视觉内容在多元化和包容性方面需要改进,希望展现更丰富的多样性,请多样性视觉专家帮我评估和优化视觉设计。

en: Our visual content needs improvement in diversity and inclusivity, and we hope to showcase richer diversity. Please, Diversity Visual Expert, help me evaluate and optimize our visual design.
